headline: Vibe Editing System
sub: Claude Code + HyperFrames · Whisper · FFmpeg · No editing app

headline: No timeline. You just ask.
lede: Claude does not open Premiere or CapCut. It writes your edit as code with HyperFrames, a free tool that turns a web page into a video, and renders it as an MP4.

headline: Six tools. Five are free.
lede: This is the whole kit, and you install it once. Claude Code is the only part you pay for. The other five are free and open source.

headline: Fifteen minutes, one time.
lede: Install Claude Code first. Then paste the prompt below and let Claude install the rest (it asks before each step), or run the commands yourself.

headline: Give Claude eyes and ears.
lede: Claude reads text and looks at images, but it cannot play a video file.

headline: Record a take Claude can edit.
lede: Claude can only edit what the camera caught. Five minutes of prep here decides how clean your cutouts, captions and effects look. A phone is enough.

headline: Plan, build, watch, repeat.
lede: Every edit runs through the same loop. Two habits make it fast: plan before Claude builds anything, and give notes like a director.

headline: The basics, ready to paste.
lede: Start here. These are the edits every talking video needs, and they tend to work on the first try.

headline: Edits that make people rewatch.
lede: These take more prep, and they are the ones people share. Each line in quotes is something you can say on camera, word for word.

headline: Show it, or just name it.
lede: Want a specific motion graphic or editing style? Show Claude an example and ask for something similar, built around what you say.

headline: Where Claude really shines.
lede: Claude edits best when the video is built on words: someone talking, a list, a process, numbers.

headline: When something looks off.
lede: Most problems have a one-line fix. Describe what you see and when, or paste the error, and let Claude work. These are the ones you will run into first.

headline: You talk. Claude edits.
lede: Install once, film one take and start with captions and cut pauses. When that feels easy, ask for your first 3D effect on camera and watch Claude build it on the exact word.
